status: CANDIDATES — not evidence. contracts/test/fork/BagDcaRealBag.fork.test.ts re-verifies every value on a pinned Robinhood fork and fails if any does not hold.

sources.bagFactory: The address itself is NOT stored here: the deployment keeps FACTORY_ADDRESS_ROBINHOOD as a secret (Netlify scans the repo for its value). The test reads it from FACTORY_ADDRESS_ROBINHOOD (environment or .env.local) and requires keccak256(lowercase address bytes) to equal bagFactoryKeccak256, the hash of the candidate recorded on research branch claude/dca-keeper-evidence (fork-registry results.json, deployment.realContracts.BAG_FACTORY, 11231 bytes). It is also compared with BagExecutionRouter.bagFactory() when that is configured.
